description: This PHP source file defines the class OpsWorksClient, which is used as a client to interact with AWS OpsWorks service. It includes method annotations for various operations like assignInstance, createApp, deleteStack, etc., indicating the available API methods for this client.

classes.name: OpsWorksClient
classes.description: A client class used to interact with the AWS OpsWorks service, providing methods to manage resources within that service.

methods.name: assignInstance
methods.description: Assigns an instance to a layer in AWS OpsWorks.

methods.name: assignInstanceAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously assigns an instance to a layer in AWS OpsWorks.

methods.name: createApp
methods.description: Creates a new application in AWS OpsWorks.

methods.name: createAppAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously creates a new application in AWS OpsWorks.

methods.name: deleteStack
methods.description: Deletes a specified stack in AWS OpsWorks.

methods.name: deleteStackAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously deletes a specified stack in AWS OpsWorks.

methods.name: updateStack
methods.description: Updates the configuration of a specified stack.

methods.name: updateStackAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously updates the configuration of a specified stack.
